title: Frontend: Global layout — collapsible sidebar + main content area
description: Create the main authenticated app layout with a collapsible left sidebar showing the project list and navigation links, and a main content area.
acceptanceCriteria: Layout renders for all authenticated routes
Sidebar shows: GitShipDone logo/name, link to dashboard, list of user's projects (name + type badge), link to Settings
Sidebar is collapsible on desktop (icon-only mode) and hidden on mobile (sheet/drawer)
Active route is highlighted in sidebar
User avatar + name shown at bottom of sidebar with dropdown (Settings, Logout)

steps.details: Create src/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx. Structure: <div class='flex h-screen'>. Sidebar on left (fixed width 240px, collapsible to 60px). Main content: <main class='flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6'>. Render <Outlet /> in main for nested routes.

Create src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx. Use shadcn/ui ScrollArea for project list. Fetch projects from /api/projects using useQuery. Render each as a NavLink with project name and type badge. Collapse button toggles width with CSS transition. Mobile: use Sheet component.

steps.description: Create user menu at sidebar bottom
steps.details: Use shadcn/ui DropdownMenu anchored to user avatar. Items: 'Settings' (link to /settings), 'Logout' (calls POST /api/auth/logout, clears auth store, navigates to /login).
Update router: wrap all authenticated routes inside AppLayout. The layout renders Outlet for its children. Apply ProtectedRoute wrapper to AppLayout.
Log in, verify sidebar shows projects. Click collapse — verify icon-only mode. Click a project in sidebar — verify navigation. On mobile viewport — verify sidebar shows as drawer.
